purpose: Characterize when exploration-guarded dual-observer allocation helps, fails, or becomes unnecessary without retuning the frozen V6 weights.
no_tuning_rule: V8 must not change the frozen 0.50/0.10/0.40/0.00 vector in response to V8 results.

same_alpha_comparators.guarded_fused_20_80: 0.50 exploration + 0.50 targeted scalar using 0.20 evidence + 0.80 observability

interpretation_rules: Do not call guarded_v6 generally superior unless it improves both event and hidden-error recovery relative to uniform in the relevant region.
If same-alpha single-observer or fused policies match or exceed guarded_v6, attribute the gain to exploration and/or simpler targeting rather than dual-observer separation.
Use V8 to map applicability and failure regions, not to select new weights.
Ecological-inference conclusions compare the raw selected sample with the explicitly retained uniform exploration subset; no post-result estimator changes are allowed.
